method: Buy/Strong Buy replayed per signal session; win = +4xATR target before -2xATR stop within 20 sessions (daily high/low); undecided excluded; equity-only by sector+type union; wins estimated from per-symbol rates rounded to 3 decimals in verdicts.json.
filter: universe type == 'Equity' AND verdict sector NOT IN {Debentures, Mutual Funds, Promoter Shares}

eval.window: most recent 250 sessions, minus the last 20 (forward window still open)

dropped.older_window_hit_rate: Not published: the builder does not retain per-symbol older-window (tune) results in the shipped archive, so no equity-only older-window figure can be recomputed from it.
dropped.frozen_regime_copy: Replaced: the previous 31.0%/11.4% regime sentences were hand-written static copy of windows that have rolled away; no 250-session window in the last 500 reproduces them.
